name: nancov
expr: C = nancov(X); C0 = nancov(X, 0); C1 = nancov(X, 1); Cv = nancov(v1, v2); cs = nancov(v1);
comment: Sig: C = nancov(X) — NaN-aware covariance matrix; rows containing any NaN are dropped (== MATLAB cov(X, 'omitrows'), the default 'complete' mode). nancov(X, normFlag) — 0 unbiased (n-1) / 1 population (n). nancov(x, y) — between two vectors; treats [x y] as 2-column matrix. Vector input → scalar variance. KNOWN GAP: 'pairwise' mode (per-(i,j) row-drop) not in v1 — only 'complete'. Bit-exact MATLAB R2025b on the documented signatures.
